fields.summary: TC-704-02: Existing Legs Not Re-Enriched When They Are Unchanged Between Versions

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-704

Precondition: A trip version update occurs where some legs are unchanged from the previous version. Only newly added or changed legs should be enriched with flight information. Unchanged legs must retain their existing flight information.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up trip V0 with 2 legs both fully enriched with flight information
V0: Leg1 DAL->HOU (enriched), Leg2 HOU->LAX (enriched). All flight fields populated.
V0 trip exists with both legs fully enriched in DynamoDB
Trigger an involuntary Save and Replace (V1) that changes only Leg2 and leaves Leg1 unchanged
V1: Leg1 DAL->HOU unchanged. Leg2 replaced with HOU->PHX (new leg, changeType=INVOL)
V1 created with Leg1 unchanged and Leg2 as a new replacement leg
Trigger the enrichment Lambda on V1
V1 payload with unchanged Leg1 and new Leg2 (HOU->PHX)
Lambda identifies Leg1 as unchanged and Leg2 as new - only Leg2 is enriched
Verify Leg1 flight information in DynamoDB is unchanged after V1 enrichment
DynamoDB record for V1 Leg1 (DAL->HOU)
Leg1 retains its original enriched flight information - no re-enrichment occurred
Verify Leg2 (HOU->PHX) has been enriched with full flight information in DynamoDB
DynamoDB record for V1 Leg2 (HOU->PHX)
Leg2 shows complete flight information: flightNumber, origin, destination, depDateTimeUTC, arrDateTimeUTC, blockOut, blockIn populated
